trace_schedule.smooth_onset: first scored window after the common preamble
trace_schedule.abrupt_onset: first scored window + SHA256-derived offset in [0,7]
trace_schedule.telegraph_burst_repetitions: registered transition rate and duration only; no method-dependent event timing
trace_schedule.trace_reuse: one immutable trace/action-opportunity sequence is replayed for every comparator

family_amplitude_semantics.step_calibration_shift: post-step mean shift = amplitude * lattice and sigma ratio = 1 + amplitude
family_amplitude_semantics.telegraph_drift: state separation = amplitude * lattice; transition probability is transition_rate_per_window
family_amplitude_semantics.burst_outlier: burst p_outlier = min(0.25, amplitude); outlier_scale = 1 + 12 * amplitude
family_amplitude_semantics.readout_reset_fault: g/e confusion = min(0.25, amplitude); duration is reset-fault dwell

family_amplitude_semantics.compound_ood: simultaneous mean/variance/correlation/readout/leakage components use the same registered tuple

selection_constraints_in_order: all pilot abrupt/OOD catastrophic and nominal non-inferiority constraints pass
maximize aggregate paired LER-improvement 95% lower bound
minimize unnecessary fallback rate then total fallback rate
threshold_selection.failure_rule: if no candidate passes all constraints, Route-A formal evaluation is NO_GO until a new protocol version is preregistered

metrics.average_ler: all scored decisions, preserving seed/family/cell membership
metrics.window: nonoverlapping 512 decisions; no rolling overlap and no window-as-independent-seed inference
metrics.p95_window_ler: empirical quantile with method='higher' over registered 512-decision windows
metrics.seed_worst_window_ler: maximum 512-decision window LER inside one seed/family across all registered cells
metrics.global_worst_window_ler: maximum observed registered window, reported with numerator/512 and trace locator
metrics.oracle_gap_closure: (static_LER-proposed_LER)/(static_LER-oracle_LER), only when paired denominator CI is strictly positive; otherwise NA with flag
metrics.adaptation_lag: transition onset to first accepted/acknowledged bank version actually used; non-recovery is right-censored
metrics.false_update: committed parameter update outside normal/smooth truth interval; truth is evaluation-only and never policy input
metrics.unnecessary_fallback: fallback selected while policy-on and policy-off actions are both correct
metrics.avoided_error: policy-off wrong and policy-on correct on the identical decision
metrics.induced_error: policy-off correct and policy-on wrong on the identical decision
metrics.deadline_miss: logical cycle, host update and future board-measured fields remain separate

statistics.independent_cluster: formal seed; all families/cells/windows for that seed are resampled together

aggregation_weights.within_family: cell estimates equally weighted within each seed
aggregation_weights.aggregate_smooth: four smooth family estimates equally weighted within each seed
aggregation_weights.aggregate_abrupt_ood: six abrupt/OOD family estimates equally weighted within each seed
aggregation_weights.nominal: reported separately and never pooled to improve a dynamic aggregate
aggregation_weights.forbidden: raw decision pooling across families/cells or post-result reweighting

strongest_baseline_selection.order: lowest equal-family pilot aggregate average LER over ten dynamic families, then p95, then worst, then MAC/wall-clock, then canonical id

hierarchy: H1 primary aggregate smooth paired LER improvement: 95% LCB > 0
H3 all abrupt/OOD catastrophic and nominal margins
only after H1-H3 pass may family-level superiority be promoted

multiplicity.p_X_p_Y_p_Z_and_cost_metrics: secondary descriptive intervals; no claim promotion

calibration_shift_tail.prior_counterexample_target: new independent formal run must not repeat proposed 55/512 > static 37/512

acceptance_gates.cnn: if real checkpoint fails matched budget/performance, retain only as ablation

failure_branches.primary_average_failure: static MAP-LUT plus deterministic FPGA claim only

prior_evidence_disclosure.disclosed_use: 55/512 proposed calibration-shift worst versus 37/512 static motivated strict new tail gate
zero Holm discovery and failed learned branch motivated independent clusters and Route-A fallback branch
compound and nominal counterexamples motivated catastrophic and nominal non-inferiority margins
method, privilege, cadence, budget and deadline schemas are frozen parent contracts

formal_result_access_at_freeze.rule: absence is recorded historically and is not rechecked after formal execution

claim_boundary.allowed: result-blind split/scenario/threshold-selection/statistical/decision-gate preregistration for new T6.7 formal evidence
